lines.text: Most kids say twenty. But there are MORE hiding!
lines.caption: Most kids say twenty. But there are MORE hiding!

lines.text: Twenty dots, in four rows of five.
lines.caption: Twenty dots, in four rows of five.

lines.text: Count every square with dot corners. Tilted ones too!
lines.caption: Count every square with dot corners. Tilted ones too!

lines.text: Is it twenty, twenty-four, twenty-six, thirty, or forty?
lines.caption: Is it twenty, twenty-four, twenty-six, thirty, or forty?

lines.text: First, the upright squares. There are twenty.
lines.caption: First, the upright squares. There are twenty.

lines.text: But look at this one, standing on its corner!
lines.caption: But look at this one, standing on its corner!

lines.text: Every two by two box hides one. That's six more.
lines.caption: Every two by two box hides one. That's six more.

lines.text: And four big tilted ones. Twenty, plus six, plus four.
lines.caption: And four big tilted ones. Twenty, plus six, plus four.

lines.text: A third of them are tilted. Easy to miss!
lines.caption: A third of them are tilted. Easy to miss!

lines.text: Want the exact working? The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
